unit: Institutes, centers and labs (Mass General Brigham-wide search)
notes: Identical search tool and URL as bwh-research.json -- see that file's notes for the full finding (606 results across the whole MGB system: 555 labs, 31 departments, 17 centers, 3 institutes; ~61 pages; Playwright-only; no hospital-level filter found). Fetched once, not duplicated. Recommend a dedicated future pass to crawl all pages and bucket labs by their home institution, shared across bwh-research, mgh-lab-search, meei-research and mgh-research-institute (all of which route through this same MGB-wide system).
